description: This C source file implements platform-dependent and utility functions for the Persistent Storage Manager's System Registry, specifically containing the function PsmCreateSysRegistry which creates a new Sys Registry object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PsmCreateSysRegistry(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new system registry object handle, passing container, owner, and reserved context handles to the implementation function PsmSysroCreate.
